en.headline: Stanley Whitney’s first Asia solo opens at Gagosian Hong Kong
en.dek: The American abstract painter’s exhibition Isn’t Love the Strangest Thing, featuring new and recent grid paintings, runs from 10 September to 7 November at the Pedder Building gallery.
body: Gagosian Hong Kong is presenting Isn’t Love the Strangest Thing, the first solo exhibition in Asia by American abstract painter Stanley Whitney, opening on 10 September 2026 and continuing until 7 November.

The show brings together new and recent paintings organised in Whitney’s characteristic loose grids of rectangular colour fields arranged in rows and separated by horizontal bands. The gallery said the title is taken from a 1936 Duke Ellington recording whose lyrics explore the unpredictable mix of joy and sorrow in love; Whitney has long drawn structural and rhythmic parallels between his colour compositions and jazz polyphony.

Works on view include pieces from the Roma series and other recent canvases ranging in scale. The gallery is at 7/F, Pedder Building, 12 Pedder Street, Central. Opening hours are Tuesday to Saturday, 11am to 7pm. An opening reception is scheduled for the evening of 10 September.

zh.headline: Stanley Whitney亞洲首個個展於高古軒香港開幕
zh.dek: 美國抽象畫家Stanley Whitney的《愛難道不是奇妙無比》展出新作及近作，9月10日至11月7日於中環畢打行高古軒舉行。
body: 高古軒香港由9月10日起至11月7日舉行美國抽象畫家Stanley Whitney亞洲首個個展《愛難道不是奇妙無比》（Isn’t Love the Strangest Thing），展出多幅新作及近期畫作。
展品延續Whitney自1990年代以來以鬆散格狀結構排列色塊、再以水平色帶分隔的創作方式。畫廊表示，展覽名稱取自Duke Ellington樂團1936年錄製的同名爵士歌曲，歌詞描寫愛情難以預料、悲喜交織的一面；Whitney長期以爵士樂的複調節奏比喻其色彩結構。
展出作品包括《羅馬》系列及其他不同尺寸的近作。展覽地點為中環畢打街12號畢打行7樓高古軒，開放時間為星期二至六上午11時至下午7時。9月10日晚設開幕酒會。
